title: Gold Under the Lighthouse

steps.text: Easy money. That sailor bet his coin and lost.
Put the coin back on the table, Candy.
Relax, Ruby. He wanted to lose it.
Another napkin map. Nobody pays for these anymore.
Yeah, I used to draw for coins, but the coins dried up.
Candy's grinning again. I know that look.
Yeah, I used to hire loud crews. Now I want quiet ones.
You're wondering what the job actually is, aren't you?
Yeah, I sketched that lighthouse once. Its map is buried under it.
The last crew who dug at that lighthouse never came back.
Ruby, don't scare the new blood off.
Tonight's the dig. Are you in, or are you scared?
I need the money. But that lighthouse scares me.

choice.say: Fine, Candy. I'm in on the dig tonight.

then.text: Knew you'd see reason. Smart crew, smart money.
Then don't say I didn't warn you.

choice.say: Count me out, Candy. I'm walking away.

then.text: Walking away from the best payday I've offered?
Good call. That dig has eaten crews before.

steps.text: Ruby knows the lighthouse ship better than anyone.
Yeah, I used to sail that ship, but I got off early.
I won't follow any map you drew, Candy.
Then draw your own map, Melissa. Keep your pride.
Here's my map. Follow it and we both eat well.
Trust mine instead. Hers only looks old.

choice.say: I'll follow your map, Candy. Let's move.

then.text: Good. Nobody doubts a map this good.
Your funeral, then. Don't cry to me later.

choice.say: I'm trusting your map, Melissa. Lead the way.

then.text: Good. My map's honest, even if it's ugly.
Ugly maps get people lost, Melissa.

choice.say: Neither. I'm burning both maps tonight.

then.text: Burn both? Then we dig blind, kid.
Bold. Blind is how crews die out there.

steps.text: That's the sailor's coin. You pocketed it earlier.
Look at the date. The lighthouse map is a forgery.

next: If justin signed on with Candy, the betrayed crew hunts him at the next port.
If justin walked out, Candy's betrayed crew still tracks him to the next port.
If justin followed Candy's map, the crew ambushes him where the dig begins.
If justin burned both maps, the crew corners him over the lost lighthouse gold.
